high_level_description: This image captures a serene scene of a multi-lane road during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the warm hues in the sky. The sky transitions from a soft orange near the horizon to a lighter blue higher up, indicating the time of day. The road is divided into multiple lanes by white dashed lines, and there are no vehicles in motion on the road at the moment the photo was taken. On the left side of the road, there is a yellow solid line marking the edge of the lane, and a black-and-white striped barrier runs along the side of the road, likely for safety purposes.
